title: Finding replication data
text: Ramey (2016) Handbook Macroeconomics data — Single zip monetary, fiscal, technology uncertainty shock series plus Stata/Matlab code used Handbook chapter. Also hosts Ramey-Zubairy (2018) military news shocks.Used : Ramey (2016); Romer Romer (2004); Christiano, Eichenbaum Evans (1999); Coibion (2012); Ramey (2011). Frequency: monthly/quarterly. Coverage: 1889-2015. Tags: monetary-policy, fiscal-policy, technology, shocks, var, local-projections, us.

title: Finding replication data
text: Romer Romer (2004) monetary policy shocks — Narrative shocks Greenbook forecasts. Updated series 2007 (Coibion et al. 2017) 2019 (Wieland Yang) circulate; Ramey zip bundles one.Used : Romer Romer (2004); Coibion (2012); Ramey (2016). Frequency: monthly. Coverage: 1969-1996. Tags: monetary-policy, narrative, shocks, us. Gertler Karadi (2015) high-frequency surprises — Replication package AEA site. Extended surprise series maintained Jarocinski Karadi (2020) Bauer Swanson (2023).Used : Gertler Karadi (2015); Ramey (2016); Jarocinski Karadi (2020). Frequency: monthly. Coverage: 1990-2012. Tags: monetary-policy, high-frequency, proxy-svar, fed-funds-futures, us. Jarocinski Karadi (2020) monetary information shocks — Poor man’s sign restrictions split high-frequency surprises. AEA replication package.Used : Jarocinski Karadi (2020). Frequency: monthly. Coverage: 1990-2019. Tags: monetary-policy, high-frequency, information-effect, us, euro-area. Bauer Swanson (2023) monetary policy surprises — Orthogonalised FOMC announcement surprises; updated author’s site.Used : Bauer Swanson (2023). Frequency: monthly. Coverage: 1988-2023. Tags: monetary-policy, high-frequency, orthogonalised, us. Miranda-Agrippino Ricco (2021) informationally-robust shocks — Monetary policy shock series purged central bank information effects.Used : Miranda-Agrippino Ricco (2021). Frequency: monthly. Coverage: 1991-2009. Tags: monetary-policy, high-frequency, bvar, us. Wu Xia (2016) shadow federal funds rate — Drop-policy rate VARs spanning zero lower bound.Used : Wu Xia (2016). Frequency: monthly. Coverage: 1990-present. Tags: monetary-policy, zlb, shadow-rate, us, euro-area, uk.

title: Finding replication data
text: Kilian (2009) oil market VAR data — World oil production, global real activity index, real oil price. activity index maintained Dallas Fed (IGREA).Used : Kilian (2009); Kilian Murphy (2014); Baumeister Hamilton (2019). Frequency: monthly. Coverage: 1973-2007. Tags: oil, svar, global-activity, us. Kilian global real economic activity index — Corrected updated Dallas Fed; download xlsx.Used : Kilian (2009); Kilian Zhou (2018). Frequency: monthly. Coverage: 1968-present. Tags: oil, global-activity, shipping, index.

title: Finding replication data
text: FRED-MD / FRED-QD — Drop-replacement Stock-Watson large panels (e.g. 120 series bbe2005). Monthly vintages archived results can pinned date.Used : McCracken Ng (2016); Stock Watson (2016); Bernanke, Boivin Eliasz (2005) updates. Frequency: monthly/quarterly. Coverage: 1959-present. Tags: factor-model, favar, big-data, us, vintages.

title: Finding replication data
text: Gilchrist Zakrajsek (2012) excess bond premium — Updated monthly Fed Board (ebp_csv.csv). ebp column gk2015.Used : Gilchrist Zakrajsek (2012); Gertler Karadi (2015). Frequency: monthly. Coverage: 1973-present. Tags: credit-spread, ebp, financial, us.

title: Finding replication data
text: Mertens Ravn (2013) narrative tax shocks — Personal corporate income tax narrative measures used external instruments.Used : Mertens Ravn (2013); Mertens Ravn (2014). Frequency: quarterly. Coverage: 1950-2006. Tags: fiscal-policy, tax, narrative, proxy-svar, us. Auerbach Gorodnichenko (2012) fiscal multipliers — AEA replication package forecasts SPF Greenbook.Used : Auerbach Gorodnichenko (2012). Frequency: quarterly. Coverage: 1947-2008. Tags: fiscal-policy, multipliers, regime-switching, stvar, us.

title: Finding replication data
text: Fernald utilization-adjusted TFP — Updated quarterly San Francisco Fed.Used : Fernald (2014); Basu, Fernald Kimball (2006); Gali (1999) updates. Frequency: quarterly. Coverage: 1947-present. Tags: tfp, technology-shocks, productivity, us.

title: Finding replication data
text: Jurado, Ludvigson Ng (2015) uncertainty indexes — Macro, real financial uncertainty 1, 3 12 month horizons; updated regularly.Used : Jurado, Ludvigson Ng (2015); Ludvigson, Ma Ng (2021). Frequency: monthly. Coverage: 1960-present. Tags: uncertainty, macro, financial, us. Economic Policy Uncertainty index — US country-level indexes plus categorical sub-indexes.Used : Baker, Bloom Davis (2016). Frequency: monthly/daily. Coverage: 1985-present. Tags: uncertainty, news, policy, us, global.

title: Finding replication data
text: Shiller online data (S&P, CAPE, house prices) — long S&P price/dividend/earnings series behind psy2015 bubble tests.Used : Shiller (1981); Campbell Shiller (1988); Phillips, Shi Yu (2015); Case Shiller (2003). Frequency: monthly/annual. Coverage: 1871-present. Tags: stock-market, dividends, cape, house-prices, bubbles, us.

title: Finding replication data

Tags: panel, credit, crises, house-prices, returns, 18-countries.
